title: KOHLER Stillness/Purist Slide Bar Trim Kit (K-974, Polished Chrome)

comparisons.notes: Kohler K-974-CP Stillness slide bar trim, polished chrome, in stock
Kohler K-974 Stillness/Purist slidebar trim kit, chrome price, in stock

writeup: Kohler's K-974 Stillness/Purist trim kit is the pair of all-metal decorative discs that dress up a K-8524 or K-9069 hand shower slide bar so it matches Stillness and Purist fixtures. Woot has the polished chrome version for $18.99, while PlumbersStock charges $33.46 and General Plumbing Supply $37.38. Only one was left at posting.
